title: Strict Tate quotient tower evaluation identity
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T, a prime ell invertible on T, d natural, an AdicTower M for datum ell, initial level isomorphisms q_n from M.level n to the single complex in degree -2d of quotientLine T ell n d, and h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d, there exist level isomorphisms q′_n with the same sources and targets for which the restriction/evaluation composite after q′_n inverse equals restriction/single followed by inverse evaluation/single at every n. The initial isomorphisms need not themselves satisfy this normalization. Use [def-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower-data], [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower].

source.place: Steps 2--3: strict ordinary quotient tower lift

proof.text: Use the existing pbcCompletedScalar map, determined by its compatible constant residues, and its projection formula. Each quotient map is surjective, so local constant representatives show that every completed-coefficient projection is locally surjective. Scalar restriction is fully faithful on ordinary quotient-module sheaves, by lifting module homomorphisms through locally lifted scalars.

The single-complex functor is fully faithful in every degree. Its exact scalar-restriction comparison identifies single followed by derived restriction with ordinary restriction followed by single. Thus this composite is fully faithful on the quotient line.

At each level compare the given evaluation transported along h with the canonical restriction/single and evaluation/single comparison. Lift their discrepancy, an automorphism of the restricted single quotient line, through the fully faithful composite. Postcompose q_n with the single of the lifted ordinary automorphism. Its inverse cancels the discrepancy. Choice collects these corrected identifications at all n.

lean.statement:
theorem strictTateTensorTower_evaluation
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (_hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (M : AdicTower T (datum.{u} ell))
    (q : ∀ n : ℕ, M.level n ≅
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).obj
        (quotientLine T ell n d))
    (h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d) :
    ∃ q' : ∀ n : ℕ, M.level n ≅
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).obj
          (quotientLine T ell n d),
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) n)).map (q' n).inv ≫
          (M.evaluation n).hom ≫
          (pbcTowerEvaluation T (pbcAdicCompletion T (datum.{u} ell)) n).map
            (eqToHom h) =
        (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
          (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) n))
          (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).hom.app (quotientLine T ell n d) ≫
        (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
          ((CategoryTheory.evaluation ℕᵒᵖ
            (pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T (datum.{u} ell)))).obj (op n))
          (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).inv.app (strictTower T ell d)

statement_change.old_statement: For a Noetherian scheme T, a prime ell invertible on T, d natural, an AdicTower M for datum ell, level isomorphisms q_n from M.level n to the single complex in degree -2d of quotientLine T ell n d, and h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d, the restriction/evaluation composite after q_n inverse equals the displayed restriction/single followed by inverse evaluation/single map at every n.
statement_change.what: The old statement was false for arbitrary q: postcomposing one q_n with a nontrivial automorphism changes the left side without changing M, h or the right side. For instance multiplication by -1 on the rank-one d=0 quotient at an odd prime does so. The repaired statement chooses corrected q′_n and proves their required normalization, preserving the existential parent theorem verbatim.
